title: 30 April 1947 — Equality, Freedom and the Next Constitutional Machinery
summary: The Assembly debates equality in public employment, reservations, titles, freedoms and restrictions, then records the Order of Business programme and authorises Union and Provincial Constitution committees.

title: Equality of Opportunity and Corrective Reservation
summary: Equal opportunity in public employment is considered alongside an express ability to provide for classes inadequately represented in public services.

title: Titles and Republican Public Life
summary: The Assembly adopts a rights clause restricting the conferral and acceptance of titles as part of the emerging constitutional order.

title: Rights of Freedom and Permissible Restrictions
summary: Expression, assembly, association, movement, residence, property and occupation are debated together with public-order, morality, emergency and public-interest qualifications.

title: Union and Provincial Constitution Committees
summary: The Assembly authorises two new committees to report on the main principles of the Union Constitution and a model Provincial Constitution as constitution-making is accelerated.
